On 12 April 2019 the Security Council adopted the United States draft S/2019/311 as resolution 2466 by 13 votes to none, with the Dominican Republic and Russia abstaining. Acting under Chapter VII, it extended MINUJUSTH for a final six months until 15 October. It requested the Secretary-General to plan a successor United Nations presence including a special political mission.

France: Chapter VII language gave MINUJUSTH means to finish tasks and implement recommendations.
Russian Federation: Objected to applying Chapter VII across entire mandate, including human rights monitoring, and questioned treating that issue as a threat to international peace.
